protocol_expansion.reason: A second v4e pre-start systemd run captured SatNOGS station 657 changing from connected to disconnected within about one hour. A single transient station state must not stop the monthly planner. Add three outcome-blind, high-volume backup stations so every registered transmitter frequency has at least two compatible campaign stations, and exclude currently disconnected or unavailable stations from a daily solve while retaining the all-target assignment gate.

protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only 50-target, thirteen-station shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.station_selection: The ten-station band-complete set plus three connected, available, non-testing backup stations chosen outcome-blind by deterministic frequency multicover with at least 10,000 prior observations.
protocol_notes.availability: Every fetch records current Network station details. Disconnected or unavailable stations are excluded for that solve; the solve still fails unless every registered target receives an assignment.
protocol_notes.target_selection: The unchanged fifty outcome-blind, count-stratified transmitter targets with a retrievable pre-start CelesTrak TLE.
protocol_notes.frequency_coverage: Frozen exact SatNOGS antenna declarations provide at least two compatible campaign stations for the selected transmitter frequency of every target.
protocol_notes.target_coverage: Every daily plan must contain at least one assignment for every registered target; remaining receiver time maximizes expected successfully decoded unique samples.
protocol_notes.continuous_visibility: Allowed visibility intervals longer than 900 seconds are divided into contiguous, independently selectable sessions with source-pass lineage; no geometry is invented between SGP4 samples.
protocol_notes.weather: Open-Meteo and NOAA forecast bodies are frozen before each solve; terrestrial weather remains evaluation-only unless a predeclared held-out gate supports the optional model.
protocol_notes.space_weather: NOAA SWPC Kp is active when available; missing future intervals stay explicitly missing.
protocol_notes.hardware: Current SatNOGS antenna identities and ranges are hard constraints and their raw station-detail responses are hash-bound; gain/noise stay null without measured declarations.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration, robustness and operational scheduling at scale, not causal yield improvement from executed recommendations.
